# Welcome to CNAS

We provide expert environmental consulting and innovative educational solutions.

## Our Services

- **Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA)** – registered with EMA.
- **Waste Management & Circular Economy** – vermicomposting, waste audits, landfill design.
- **Carbon Advisory & Net Zero Strategy** – carbon footprint measurement and decarbonisation.
- **Training & Capacity Building** – farmers' training, SHEQ, HAZOP.
- **TheTeacher.AI** – AI-powered WhatsApp chatbot supporting Zimbabwean teachers from ECD to Form 6.
